purpose: Fix 00.31 infinite loading regression and remove deep PAC validation from Vita profile startup.

hardware_00_31_findings.frame_loop: continues at ~60 FPS with no further state/resource progress

root_causes.downloader_polarity: Original APK Downloader.isDownload() returns DownloadTask.isEnd(), whose bDL is true while the request is still running and false after completion. 00.31 incorrectly returned true forever.
root_causes.startup_audit: 00.31 performed auditInstalledData() during dbtb_initResources(), parsing every character PAC before original-engine startup.

fixes.downloader: Vita offline stub now returns isDownload=false, GetData=null, GetSize=0, taking the original engine's normal failed/offline request path immediately.
fixes.roster_scan: Startup uses scanInstalledData(): presence/contiguity only; deep PAC parsing remains available for tooling/tests but is not performed before engine start.

build.layout: 24 balanced TeaVM remainder units at -O1; TCBManajer at -O0; native adapters at -O2
